{{Top|leg}}
The '''Roh tribe''' was a village of [[Fyodoi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]]. They were led by [[Kalor (Fyodos)|Kalor]], and their [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] was [[Tseeach]].
